title: On Frobenius rigidity for motivic cohomology
summary: We study how motivic and étale motivic cohomology of a smooth and proper variety changes under extensions of algebraically closed base fields $k$. With finite coefficients, motivic cohomology is independent of $k$, and étale motivic cohomology is independent of $k$ away from the characteristic, but depends on $k$ at the characteristic. We then consider the fiber of $F-1$ for $F$ the Frobenius, on motivic cohomology and étale motivic cohomology for varieties defined over finite fields.
